business_summary: Zhong Jia Guo Xin Holdings Company Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the property development and investment business in the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. It is also involved in the production and sales of bottled mineral water; securities trading; mineral exploration and mining; and provision of management services. The company was formerly known as Asia Resources Holdings Limited and changed its name to Zhong Jia Guo Xin Holdings Company Limited in January 2024. Zhong Jia Guo Xin Holdings Company Limited was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Sai Wan, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Zhong Jia Guo Xin Holdings Company Limited는 중화인민공화국과 홍콩에서 부동산 개발 및 투자 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 또한 생수 생산 및 판매에도 참여하고 있습니다. 증권 거래; 광물 탐사 및 채광; 및 관리 서비스 제공. 이 회사는 이전에 Asia Resources Holdings Limited로 알려졌으며 2024년 1월에 Zhong Jia Guo Xin Holdings Company Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. Zhong Jia Guo Xin Holdings Company Limited는 1997년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 사이완에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
